General
1.1. Metin2 Singleplayer is a free fan project: the server runs on your own computer and the world is populated by bots (Playerbots). The project is not affiliated with Gameforge or Webzen.[ENTER]1.2. Releases and updates of the project are published on GitHub: github.com/TieruYT/metin2-playerbots.[ENTER]1.3. You play at your own risk. The project is provided "as is", without any warranty.
Rules
2.1. On your own server you play as you like. The admin / admin account is the test account of your installation.[ENTER]2.2. If you share the server with friends, you are its administrator and you keep order: fair play, respect for others, no cheating and no spoiling other people's game.[ENTER]2.3. Do not pass the package off as your own and do not make money from it. Since version 2.2.55 the project is licensed under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (the LICENSE file in the server folder): you may use it and share the official packages unchanged if you credit the author and do not make money from it; you may not share adaptations or separate distributions. The project is and stays free.
Supporting the project
3.1. Development, testing and the test server cost time and money. If you enjoy the project, you can buy the authors a coffee: buycoffee.to/metin2-playerbots.[ENTER]3.2. Support is entirely voluntary and unlocks nothing in the game.
Community and help
4.1. The project's Discord: discord.gg/DyCxXdZtnV - report bugs, ideas and questions there; news of new versions appears there too.[ENTER]4.2. When you report a bug, attach the log bundle from the launcher (DIAGNOSTICS, "Collect logs (ZIP)"). Without it, hardly anything can be fixed.
Privacy
5.1. Everything runs locally: the client connects only to 127.0.0.1, and the server opens no ports to the outside.[ENTER]5.2. The game sends your data nowhere. The launcher connects to GitHub only to check whether there is a new version.
Changes to these rules
6.1. A new version of the game may bring new content to this window. It will then be shown again at your next login.[ENTER]6.2. Have fun!

3. Postęp graczy określany jest za pomocą rzutu pałeczkami Yut. Liczba pól, o którą dany[ENTER]
graczy może posunąć się do przodu, zależy od liczby pałeczek, które po rzucie ułożą się[ENTER]

punktowanym rzucie.[ENTER]
5. Kliknij na "Rzuć". Twój ruch wyświetla się na dole. Wybierz pionek, którym chcesz go[ENTER]
wykonać.[ENTER]
6. Jeśli trafisz na pole ze strzałką, możesz użyć skrótu.[ENTER]

RZUTY I RUCHY[ENTER]
[ENTER]
Do - płaska strona u góry: posuń się o 1 pole do przodu.[ENTER]
Ge - dwie płaskie strony u góry: posuń się o 2 pola do przodu.[ENTER]
Geol - trzy płaskie strony u góry: posuń się o 3 pola do przodu.[ENTER]
Yut - cztery płaskie strony u góry: posuń się o 4 pola do przodu.[ENTER]

masz pionka na planszy, musisz pominąć jedną kolejkę.[ENTER]
[ENTER]
Job-gi: jeśli trafisz dokładnie na pole, na którym znajduje się pionek komputera, zbijasz[ENTER]
go i otrzymujesz 10 punktów.[ENTER]
Up-gi: jeśli dwa Twoje pionki znajdą się na tym samym polu, od następnego ruchu posuwasz[ENTER]
obydwa do przodu.[ENTER]

WSKAZÓWKA[ENTER]
[ENTER]

otrzymasz nagrody. Nagroda za ukończoną grę czeka na Ciebie - jeśli jej nie odbierzesz,[ENTER]

NAGRODY[ENTER]
[ENTER]
220 punktów i więcej: Złote Trofeum Yutnori[ENTER]
150 - 219 punktów: Srebrne Trofeum Yutnori[ENTER]
poniżej 150 punktów: Brązowy Pakiet Yutnori[ENTER]
[ENTER]

WELCOME TO METIN2'S YUT NORI![ENTER]
[ENTER]
Hunt monsters to gather Birch Branches. Craft a Yut Nori Board from 28 Birch Branches and[ENTER]
let the fun begin. Amazing prizes are waiting to be won![ENTER]
[ENTER]
HOW TO PLAY[ENTER]
[ENTER]
1. You play against the computer.[ENTER]
2. Each player has two pieces. Whichever player brings both pieces home first is the[ENTER]
winner.[ENTER]
3. Instead of dice, the game uses Yut Sticks. The number of spaces you can move is[ENTER]
determined by how many sticks land with the flat side facing up.[ENTER]
4. The first throw determines the starting player. The player with the lowest score[ENTER]
begins.[ENTER]
5. Click on 'Throw'. Your move is displayed below. Select the piece you wish to move.[ENTER]
6. If you land directly on a space with an arrow, you can take the shortcut.[ENTER]
[ENTER]
THROWS AND MOVES[ENTER]
[ENTER]
Do (one flat side up): Move forwards 1 space[ENTER]
Gae (two flat sides up): Move forwards 2 spaces[ENTER]
Geol (three flat sides up): Move forwards 3 spaces[ENTER]
Yut (four flat sides up): Move forwards 4 spaces[ENTER]
Mo (four rounded sides up): Move forwards 5 spaces[ENTER]
Back Do (only marked stick with flat side up): Move backwards 1 space. If you do not have[ENTER]
a token on the board, you will have to wait a turn.[ENTER]
[ENTER]
Job-gi: Landing directly on a space occupied by the computer's token removes it from the[ENTER]
board and you receive 10 points.[ENTER]
Up-gi: If both of your pieces end the turn on the same space, you move them as one[ENTER]
starting with the next turn.[ENTER]
Throw again: If you score a Yut or Mo, you get another turn.[ENTER]
[ENTER]
You can increase your chances of landing a certain throw. Simply select it from the[ENTER]
relevant menu.[ENTER]
[ENTER]
SCORE[ENTER]
[ENTER]
1. Throwing the Yut Sticks: -10[ENTER]
2. Catching the computer's piece: +10[ENTER]
3. Computer catches your piece: -10[ENTER]
4. Getting your piece home: +10[ENTER]
5. Computer gets piece home: -10[ENTER]
[ENTER]
NOTE[ENTER]
[ENTER]
If you abandon the game or leave the map on which you are playing, you will not receive[ENTER]
any reward.
